from copy import deepcopy
from datetime import date
import hashlib
import hmac
import json

import pytest

from trialops.privacy import export_subjects


ON = date(2024, 6, 15)


def make_subject(subject_id="subject-one", **changes):
    record = {
        "id": subject_id,
        "name": "Fictional Person",
        "birth_date": "1990-04-03",
        "email": "person@example.test",
        "country": "NZ",
        "visits": ["2024-05-01", "2024-01-02"],
        "consents": [{"purpose": "research", "signed_on": "2024-06-15"}],
        "purge_after": "2024-06-15",
    }
    record.update(changes)
    return record


def pseudonym(subject_id, *, purpose="research", secret="test-secret"):
    message = f"{purpose}:{subject_id}".encode("utf-8")
    return hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), message, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()[:16]


def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
    )


def test_active_boundaries_sorting_schema_and_canonical_manifest():
    subjects = [make_subject("subject-b"), make_subject("subject-a")]
    original = deepcopy(subjects)

    result = export_subjects(subjects, purpose="research", secret="test-secret", on=ON)

    expected_rows = [
        {
            "pseudonym": pseudonym("subject-a"),
            "country": "NZ",
            "birth_year": 1990,
            "visits": ["2024-01-02", "2024-05-01"],
        },
        {
            "pseudonym": pseudonym("subject-b"),
            "country": "NZ",
            "birth_year": 1990,
            "visits": ["2024-01-02", "2024-05-01"],
        },
    ]
    expected_rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["pseudonym"])
    assert result["rows"] == expected_rows
    assert result["manifest"] == {
        "algorithm": "sha256",
        "count": 2,
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical(expected_rows).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
    }
    assert subjects == original


def test_withdrawal_on_on_is_inactive_but_later_withdrawal_is_active():
    withdrawn = make_subject("withdrawn")
    withdrawn["consents"][0]["withdrawn_on"] = "2024-06-15"
    active = make_subject("active")
    active["consents"][0]["withdrawn_on"] = "2024-06-16"
    expired = make_subject("expired", purge_after="2024-06-14")

    result = export_subjects(
        [withdrawn, active, expired], purpose="research", secret="test-secret", on=ON
    )

    assert [row["pseudonym"] for row in result["rows"]] == [pseudonym("active")]
    assert result["manifest"]["count"] == 1


def test_empty_input_has_canonical_empty_manifest():
    assert export_subjects([], purpose="research", secret="test-secret", on=ON) == {
        "rows": [],

            "algorithm": "sha256",
            "count": 0,
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(b"[]").hexdigest(),

import json

import pytest

from trialops.privacy import execute_reuse_export, export_subjects
from tests.test_privacy import make_subject


NOW = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
SECRET = "integration-secret"


def approved_request(**changes):
    purpose = "research"
    value = {
        "id": "reuse-001",
        "requester": "alice",
        "reviewer": "bob",
        "purpose": purpose,
        "status": "approved",
        "retention_until": "2025-06-30",

        "metadata": {
            "representative": True,
            "complete": True,
            "quality_score": 0.95,
        },
        "history": [],
    }
    value.update(changes)
    return value


def serialized(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)


def unconsumable_subjects():
    raise AssertionError("subjects were consumed")
    yield


def test_execute_reuse_export_uses_snapshot_purpose_and_utc_date_once():
    request = approved_request()
    subjects = [make_subject("sensitive-subject")]
    original_request = deepcopy(request)
    original_subjects = deepcopy(subjects)

    with patch(
        "trialops.privacy.export_subjects", wraps=export_subjects
    ) as export_call:
        executed = execute_reuse_export(
            request, subjects, actor="alice", secret=SECRET, now=NOW
        )

    expected = export_subjects(subjects, purpose="research", secret=SECRET, on=NOW.date())
    assert export_call.call_count == 1
    assert export_call.call_args.kwargs == {
        "purpose": "research",
        "secret": SECRET,
        "on": NOW.date(),
    }
    assert executed["status"] == "executed"
    assert executed["execution_result"] == expected
    assert executed["history"][-1] == {
        "action": "execute",
        "actor": "alice",
        "at": "2025-01-01T12:00:00Z",
    }
    assert request == original_request
    assert subjects == original_subjects
    for identifier in (
        "sensitive-subject",
        "Fictional Person",
        "person@example.test",
        "1990-04-03",
        SECRET,
    ):
        assert identifier not in serialized(executed)


def test_governance_failures_and_repeated_execution_do_not_consume_subjects():
    with pytest.raises(PermissionError, match="REQUESTER_REQUIRED"):
        execute_reuse_export(
            approved_request(),
            unconsumable_subjects(),
            actor="bob",
            secret=SECRET,
            now=NOW,
        )

    expired = approved_request(approval_expires_on="2024-12-31")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="APPROVAL_EXPIRED"):
        execute_reuse_export(
            expired, unconsumable_subjects(), actor="alice", secret=SECRET, now=NOW
        )

    already_executed = approved_request(status="executed")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="INVALID_STATE"):
        execute_reuse_export(
            already_executed,
            unconsumable_subjects(),
            actor="alice",
            secret=SECRET,
            now=NOW,
        )


def test_export_failure_is_sanitized_and_rolls_back_request_and_history():
    request = approved_request(
        history=[{"action": "approve", "actor": "bob", "at": "2024-12-31T12:00:00Z"}]
    )
    original = deepcopy(request)
    duplicate = make_subject("sensitive-duplicate")

    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as caught:
        execute_reuse_export(
            request,
            [duplicate, deepcopy(duplicate)],
            actor="alice",
            secret=SECRET,
            now=NOW,
        )

    assert str(caught.value) == "EXECUTION_FAILED"
    assert request == original
    assert request["status"] == "approved"
    assert request["history"] == original["history"]
    assert "execution_result" not in request
    for identifier in ("sensitive-duplicate", "person@example.test", SECRET):
        assert identifier not in str(caught.value)

        request, [subject], actor="alice", secret=SECRET, now=now
    )

    assert executed["execution_result"]["manifest"]["count"] == 1
    assert executed["history"][-1]["at"] == "2025-01-01T22:30:00Z"
